company_name: 广东万和新电气股份有限公司
decision_frame: Pre-outcome underwriting of the consolidated appliance enterprise using only FY2015-FY2017 disclosures; no prices, returns or actions are inferred.
underwriting_route: Underwrite mature gas-appliance earnings and survival; conditionally test newer boiler/JV growth and cash accessibility before promotion.

situation_model.summary: 万和以燃气热水器和燃气具为核心，向厨电、净水及热水系统延伸，收入增长伴随存货、受限资产和短期借款上升；分产品盈利与现金归属未披露。

industry_future_thesis.most_likely_regime: Mature domestic appliance competition with channel migration and selective growth in wall-hung boilers and integrated hot-water systems.
industry_future_thesis.profit_pool_transmission: Scale and channel coverage can support volume, but bargaining power, promotional intensity and mix determine whether revenue growth reaches operating profit and cash.
industry_future_thesis.company_exposure: 万和覆盖专卖店、KA、直供、直营和电商，并有海外合作；其核心仍是燃气具，新增壁挂炉及博世合资热水业务扩大资本和 execution exposure.
industry_future_thesis.adaptation: Existing multi-channel and OEM/ODM capabilities provide adaptation options; FY2017 boiler growth and new JV operations are implementation evidence, not yet mature-return evidence.
industry_future_thesis.normal_economics: Consolidated earnings were positive and substantial across FY2015-FY2017, but segment margins, customer concentration and growth-cohort cash conversion remain unknown.
industry_future_thesis.permanent_loss: Persistent inventory absorption, restricted cash, low-return expansion or structural margin pressure could erode per-share value without threatening near-term solvency.
industry_future_thesis.valuation_treatment: Use a mature-core earning-power route as primary; keep boiler/JV growth and inaccessible-cash uplift conditional or excluded until matched returns and realization are disclosed.
industry_future_thesis.strongest_rival: 大型综合厨电品牌凭借渠道、品牌与规模优势压缩万和燃气具利润池
reversal_observations: Official reports show sustained core-appliance margin and cash conversion despite competitive and channel changes.
Product-level disclosures reconcile boiler/JV investment, working capital and incremental owner cash at a responsibility-matched boundary.
Entity-level cash ownership, restrictions and distributions demonstrate ordinary-shareholder accessibility materially different from the conservative case.

business_position: The company has national channel breadth, multiple brands and OEM/ODM formats, with gas water heaters as the anchor and overseas cooperation as an option; disclosed data do not establish a durable segment advantage.
survival_case: Operating cash flow was RMB679m, RMB884m and RMB873m in FY2015-FY2017. Short-term borrowings rose to RMB201m in FY2017 while long-term borrowings stayed RMB7.8m; liquidity appears serviceable, but RMB265m of cash and notes were restricted and inventory reached RMB1.46bn.
adaptation_case: Boiler revenue reached RMB680.0m in FY2017 (165.51% growth) and Bosch joint ventures entered operation. These initiatives broaden the addressable market, yet product-level returns, cumulative investment and working-capital absorption are not disclosed, so adaptation remains conditional.
normalization_case: Reference consolidated attributable earnings are bounded at RMB360m-RMB430m, anchored by FY2015-FY2017 attributable and recurring-profit disclosures. No segment adjustment is credited for boiler/JV growth because its incremental economics are unobserved.
permanent_loss_map: Permanent-loss paths are slow margin erosion from scale competition, cash absorption in inventory/receivables and restricted balances, and retention of capital in projects or JVs without demonstrated incremental return; survival strength does not remove these per-share risks.

value_route.route_reasoning: A mature-core earning-power route is the only route with a multi-year consolidated earnings anchor. Boiler/JV growth, export detail and financing stress are retained as conditional or excluded routes because component-level cash and return evidence is missing.

strongest_rival: 大型综合厨电品牌凭借渠道、品牌与规模优势压缩万和燃气具利润池

component_treatments.reason: Gas appliances are the stated core and consolidated recurring profit is disclosed for three years, although segment margins are unavailable.
component_treatments.investment_consequence: Forms the only base earning-power anchor.
component_treatments.promotion_or_resolution_condition: Disclose sustained product-level margin and cash conversion through a competitive period.

component_treatments.reason: Boiler revenue grew rapidly and Bosch JVs commenced, but no matched incremental profit, cash or total capital is disclosed.
component_treatments.investment_consequence: Excluded from base earnings and treated as a conditional growth option.
component_treatments.promotion_or_resolution_condition: Provide cohort-level revenue, margin, invested capital, working-capital absorption and owner cash.

component_treatments.reason: Export regions and customer cooperation are described without customer concentration, contract terms or component cash data.
component_treatments.investment_consequence: No separate export value or earnings uplift is recognized.
component_treatments.promotion_or_resolution_condition: Disclose customer concentration, receivable aging and product-level export economics.

component_treatments.reason: Inventory, receivables, fixed-asset spending and short-term debt are material at consolidated level, but maintenance versus growth spending is not split.
component_treatments.investment_consequence: Raises financing pressure and permanent-loss sensitivity; no invented owner-cash point estimate.
component_treatments.promotion_or_resolution_condition: Reconcile maintenance and growth capital, inventory turns and cash release by component.

component_treatments.reason: Consolidated cash and restricted balances are disclosed, but entity ownership, restrictions and upstream distributions are not mapped.
component_treatments.investment_consequence: Only a conservative conditional owner-cash contribution is allowed; no full cash add-on.
component_treatments.promotion_or_resolution_condition: Map cash-holding entities, restrictions, taxes and ordinary-shareholder distributions.

component_decisions.promotion_test: Segment margin and cash conversion remain stable across a full cycle.
component_decisions.invalidation_test: Core margins or cash conversion deteriorate materially for reasons not offset by mix.

component_decisions.promotion_test: Matched cohort return and owner cash exceed capital and working-capital absorption.
component_decisions.invalidation_test: Growth requires continuing capital with no evidence of adequate incremental return.

component_decisions.promotion_test: Customer and receivable data permit a bounded export economics bridge.
component_decisions.invalidation_test: Concentration or payment terms reveal material downside not captured in core.

component_decisions.promotion_test: Maintenance and growth spending are separated and inventory normalizes without debt escalation.
component_decisions.invalidation_test: Working-capital absorption and debt continue rising faster than operating cash.

component_decisions.promotion_test: Entity-level ownership and repeated distributions establish accessibility.
component_decisions.invalidation_test: Restrictions, minority claims or tax friction prevent upstream realization.

evidence_trace.scope: Core gas-appliance business, product extension and business models.
FY2015-FY2017 revenue, attributable and recurring profit.
Bosch joint ventures entering operation and product scope.
Export regions, customers and domestic channels.

evidence_trace.locator: FY2015-FY2017 annual reports cash-flow tables and FY2017 p.23-24
evidence_trace.scope: Operating cash, capital spending, receivables, inventory and borrowings.
RMB265.3m restricted monetary funds and pledged notes.
Core demand and channel exposure proxy.
evidence_trace.used_for: Sensitivity input case; no magnitude asserted.

underwriting_thesis.central_path: A real mature gas-appliance earnings base supports survival and a primary earning-power route, while growth initiatives and consolidated cash require responsibility-matched proof before they can increase owner economics.
underwriting_thesis.normal_earnings_treatment: Use RMB360m-RMB430m consolidated attributable reference range; do not capitalize unproven boiler/JV growth.
underwriting_thesis.owner_cash_treatment: Operating cash is positive, but inventory/capex absorption and restricted balances require a conditional accessible-cash range rather than a point estimate.
underwriting_thesis.permanent_loss_treatment: Monitor slow per-share erosion from competition, retention and inaccessible cash even with adequate near-term solvency.
underwriting_thesis.value_route_treatment: Primary route is mature-core earning power; growth and export routes remain scenario, stress or unresolved until evidence closes.
underwriting_thesis.strongest_rival: 大型综合厨电品牌凭借渠道、品牌与规模优势压缩万和燃气具利润池
underwriting_thesis.monitoring: At the early-signal clock, check core margin, channel mix and competitive response; at normalization-and-cash clock, reconcile component returns, inventory, capital spending, debt and distributions.

investment_treatment: Research-only pre-outcome treatment: underwrite the mature core, conditionally underwrite growth and cash accessibility, and keep price, return and action conclusions unresolved.

normal_earnings_bridge.economic_reason: Three-year consolidated attributable and recurring-profit disclosures anchor a broad pre-cutoff earning range.

quantification.reason: Segment margins and one-off allocation are not disclosed separately from consolidated results.
quantification.conservative_treatment: Make no additional adjustment; retain the consolidated reference range.

normal_earnings_bridge.economic_reason: Core business is the anchor, but no defensible segment adjustment can be calculated.

quantification.reason: Rapid boiler growth lacks product-level profit and cash conversion disclosure.
quantification.conservative_treatment: Exclude incremental growth from base earnings; revisit conditionally when matched return data arrive.

normal_earnings_bridge.economic_reason: Revenue growth alone does not establish mature earnings.

driver_sensitivity_specs.metric: core appliance demand and channel throughput

low.basis: Downside demand case from disclosed channel exposure; magnitude not disclosed.

base.basis: Base demand case for mature core.

high.basis: Upside demand case for mature core.

normal_earnings.basis: Segment margin and volume elasticity are not disclosed.

delta.reason: No responsibility-matched sensitivity magnitude is available.
delta.conservative_treatment: Do not assign a numeric earnings delta.

owner_cash.basis: Demand-to-cash conversion is obscured by inventory and receivable changes.

delta.reason: Working-capital response by core component is not disclosed.
delta.conservative_treatment: Do not assign a numeric owner-cash delta.

driver_sensitivity_specs.responsibility_boundary: Consolidated mature gas-appliance core; excludes boiler/JV and export components.
